species.summary: American alligator is a reptile with federal status Similarity of Appearance (Threatened). Keep your distance if you see one. Never feed an alligator. Report a threat to FWC.
American crocodile is a reptile with federal status Threatened. Keep your distance if you see one. Never feed a crocodile. Report a threat to FWC.
Eastern indigo snake is a reptile with federal status Threatened. Stop activity near the snake until procedure is followed. Do not harm it. Notify USFWS.
Florida bonneted bat is a mammal with federal status Endangered. Do not touch or handle a bat. Wash contact areas with soap and water. Report contact promptly.
Florida panther is a mammal with federal status Endangered. Do not run. Give space to leave. Face the animal and stand tall. Make yourself look larger.
Puma (=mountain lion) is a mammal with federal status Similarity of Appearance (Threatened). Do not run. Give space to leave. Face the animal and stand tall.
Tricolored bat is a mammal with federal status Proposed Endangered. Do not touch or handle a bat. Wash contact areas with soap and water. Report contact promptly.
